digest.en: Europe & Russia leads the board this hour with Ukrainian Soldiers Brave Russian Drones On Trek To Frontline Settlements. Asia-Pacific carries the next thread. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर एशिया-प्रशांत की अगुवाई है, भारत के पड़ोस में फिर चिंघाड़ भरने लगी ये नदी, तबाही का पहला सिग्नल, 3 हाईवे पर लाल निशान मुख्य खबर है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: Ukrainian Soldiers Brave Russian Drones On Trek To Frontline Settlements
articles.summary: Ukrainian troops trek nearly 20 kilometers to reach Bilozerske in the embattled Donetsk region. Russian drone and aerial attacks have laid waste to the city that used to house 15,000 inhabitants. Speaking with RFE/RL, one soldier said that "everything is bad" near Dobropillia. Ukrainian Soldiers Brave Russian Drones On Trek To Frontline Settlements.

articles.title: Trump-Xi summit puts focus on managing US-China rivalry
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping’s personal rapport helped set a warm tone in Washington this week, but analysts say lasting stability will depend on whether the two sides can better manage their unresolved differences. Trump-Xi summit puts focus on managing US-China rivalry.

articles.title: More growth but fewer workers needed? Countries grapple with the risk of 'jobless growth' amid AI
articles.summary: What happens when an economy keeps getting richer, but no longer needs as many new workers to grow? As AI reshapes how companies operate and where economic value is created, Singapore may need to rethink the relationship between growth, jobs and prosperity, experts say. More growth but fewer workers needed? Countries grapple with the risk of 'jobless growth' amid AI.

articles.summary: As co-living takes root in more condominiums, some residents in at least one condo are up in arms. articles.title: Six years on from COVID-19, is the world ready for the next pandemic?
articles.summary: COVID-19 killed millions, shattered health systems and brought the global economy to a virtual standstill. World leaders are meeting Friday to review the lessons learned and cement a new approach to prevention and preparation for the next pandemic. Hopes are high that a World Health Organization-led international agreement can move forward. Six years on from COVID-19, is the world ready for the next pandemic?

articles.title: Yemen violence deepens concerns over child hunger crisis
articles.summary: Aid agencies in Yemen highlighted the growing hunger emergency sparked by renewed fighting between Houthi opposition forces and Government troops, after mobile health clinics reported that hundreds of children displaced by the violence are suffering from the most deadly form of malnutrition. Yemen violence deepens concerns over child hunger crisis.

articles.title: As Deadline Looms, Ex-US Marine Desperately Seeks Brother At Afghan Refugee Camp In Qatar
articles.summary: A former US Marine spent days in Doha trying to meet his brother at an Afghan refugee camp that will close on 30 September. The camp houses 2,000 refugees whose planned transfer to the United States was halted by a presidential executive order. The inmates face an uncertain future. A former US Marine has spent days trying to see his brother at a camp in Qatar holding Afghan refugees in limbo after plans to bring them to the United States were blocked by a presidential executive order.

articles.summary: RFE/RL takes apart a Russian Geran-4 drone to uncover what makes the jet-powered unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) faster, harder to intercept, and capable of operating deep inside Ukraine -- from its turbojet engine and advanced camera to foreign-made communications and navigation components. articles.title: ‘We’re going to win. We have no other choice’
articles.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told the UN General Assembly that Israel’s strikes on Iran are a matter of national survival. He dismissed West Bank violence as the work of a handful of juvenile delinquents and called accusations of genocide in Gaza the greatest lie of the century. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu used his address to the UN General Assembly to defend Israel’s strikes against Iran as a matter of national survival and describe the violence in the West Bank as the work of few “juvenile delinquents” and reject accusations of genocide in Gaza as “the greatest lie of the century.”.

articles.title: Palestinian existence under threat, Abbas tells UN, warning of ‘another Nakba’
articles.summary: Israeli policies now threaten “the very life and existence of the Palestinian people on their homeland”, Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas told the UN General Assembly on Thursday, urging the world not to allow “another Nakba”. Palestinian existence under threat, Abbas tells UN, warning of ‘another Nakba’.

articles.title: World leaders approve new declaration to tackle rising sea levels
articles.summary: Sea level rise is among the most visible consequences of global warming, but for some countries, it is an imminent existential threat. World leaders meet Thursday to adopt a new declaration and debate the best ways to strengthen international cooperation and support vulnerable low-lying nations most at risk. World leaders tackle sea level rise, a stark marker of climate change.

articles.title: US Pushes To Turn Armenia-Azerbaijan Transit Deal Into Investment Opportunity
articles.summary: The Trump administration is trying to turn a US-brokered opening between Armenia and Azerbaijan into something more tangible: a transport corridor linking Central Asia and the South Caucasus with Western markets -- and an investment opportunity for American companies. US Pushes To Turn Armenia-Azerbaijan Transit Deal Into Investment Opportunity.

articles.title: इज़रायली सेना ने मार गिराए दो हमास आतंकी
articles.summary: आतंकी संगठन हमास (Hamas) को खत्म करने के लिए गाज़ा (Gaza) और आसपास के इलाकों में इज़रायल (Israel) की सैन्य कार्रवाई जारी है। इज़रायली सेना अब तक बड़ी संख्या में हमास आतंकियों को मार चुकी है, लेकिन अभी भी बचे हुए आतंकियों को मार गिराने के लिए गाज़ा में हमले जारी हैं। अब इज़रायली सेना को हमास के खिलाफ युद्ध में फिर से कामयाबी मिली है।

articles.summary: पाकिस्तान के पूर्व सूचना मंत्री मुशाहिद हुसैन ने एक बड़ा खुलासा किया है. उन्होंने बताया कि 1980 के दशक में अमरीकी एजेंसी CIA और सऊदी अरब ने 'अफगान जिहाद' के नाम पर पाक एजेंसी ISI को 5 अरब डॉलर देकर एक ‘भस्मासुर’ खड़ा किया था. इनमें ओसामा बिन लादेन और अयमन अल-जवाहिरी जैसे खूंखार आतंकी भी शामिल थे. इतना ही नहीं, पाकिस्तान ने इसी फंडिंग और दुनिया के भटके ध्यान का फायदा उठाकर चुपके से अपने परमाणु हथिय।

articles.summary: Chilling Prediction About Humanity: हमारी दुनिया में बहुत कुछ ऐसा है, जो रोजाना देखने के बाद भी हम नजरअंदाज कर देते हैं. इसे लेकर अमेरिकी इतिहासकार जेरेड डायमंड ने ऐसी भविष्यवाणी की है, जो डरा देने वाली है. ये कई ज्योतिष की गणना नहीं बल्कि मौजूदा हालात को देखते हुए 25 साल बाद का खौफनाक भविष्य है. 2050 तक खत्म हो जाएगी हमारी दुनिया?
